h: Nigeria Customs shares an update on its recruitment exercise
p: The Nigeria Customs Service has reportedly issued fresh details on its recruitment exercise, which it says is moving to an annual cycle. Candidates are advised to rely only on the service's official channels for information.
more: The previous exercise reportedly selected 3,852 candidates from more than 573,000 applicants.
Successful candidates have been told to watch their registered email and SMS for instructions.
